title: 3 Tips to Effectively Pivot In Your Career
description:
If you’re thinking about a career pivot how can you use all your work history and current experience to effectively transition?

Here are 3 tips…

1) Always be confident but always be honest.

2) No “Aspiring ____”

3) Use transferrable skills to show your impact and value.
